rungs.title: Junior Backend Developer
rungs.summary: Learning the server side: APIs, data and tests.
rungs.knowledge: Knows one back-end language and the basics of HTTP, SQL and Git.
rungs.delivery: Builds endpoints and queries from a clear spec with review on everything.
rungs.leadership: Reports blockers early and learns how the front end uses their work.

rungs.title: Backend Developer
rungs.summary: Designs and ships reliable APIs and data models.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in APIs, relational data, authentication and testing.
rungs.delivery: Ships an API or service with tests, migrations and light review.
rungs.leadership: Agrees contracts with front end clearly and documents what they build.

rungs.title: Senior Backend Developer
rungs.summary: Owns services, their data and their reliability.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in data modelling, performance, queues and caching; works with infrastructure and security operations.
rungs.delivery: Owns services in production: design, rollout, monitoring and incidents.
rungs.leadership: Reviews, mentors and leads projects across teams.

rungs.title: Backend Lead
rungs.summary: Leads the back-end practice, architecture and delivery.
rungs.knowledge: Shapes the architecture and the infrastructure it runs on.
rungs.delivery: Plans and delivers cross-team back-end work and owns reliability targets.
rungs.leadership: Leads a team's delivery and sets standards for the back end.

rungs.title: Principal Backend Engineer
rungs.summary: The company's authority on the back end.
rungs.knowledge: Recognised expert on scale, data and failure; sets the long-term direction.
rungs.delivery: Solves the hardest back-end problems and removes whole classes of them.
rungs.leadership: Indispensable advisor to architecture and leadership.
